audit.why: HARD / 7/10 matches a 44.76% win rate over 105 games, and the chart gives Sejuani everything through level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] and whys[4] are labelled 'level 4' and 'level 5', but those rows are Levels 4-5 and Level 6.
audit.why: Row 4 is the Level 6 row — that is where Glacial Prison arrives, and it is the single biggest swing in the matchup.
audit.corrected: whys[3] covers 4-5 (Wuju/Meditate but she is still too tanky); whys[4] names Glacial Prison at 6 and that Highlander's slow immunity does not touch a stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d call the stun 'Arctic Assault' — that is her Q knockup. The stun is Permafrost (E). Both also treat the stun as a long-cooldown ability to bait.
audit.why: Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown, 20 mana, point-and-click, and it can only be cast on a target at MAXIMUM Frost stacks. Frost comes from Winter's Wrath (W), which is 9/8/7/6/5s. So the resource to deny is Frost stacks, not the E cooldown. Fury of the North (P) also lets her shatter a stunned target for heavy magic damage, and her Frost Armor grants slow immunity of its own. Meditate (W) is a channel and her E/R/passive CC cancels it (missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: Name Permafrost (E) as the stun; state that it only fires at max Frost and that denying Winter's Wrath hits denies the stun; Arctic Assault (Q) is the 12-18s gap-closer; never channel Meditate inside her CC range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shatter on Fury of the North is never mentioned.
audit.why: Damaging a stunned enemy shatters for massive magic damage — that is why her stun ends trades, not the stun duration.

edits.before: Her Permafrost (E) stun comes online and locks you at level 2.
edits.after: Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost so Permafrost (E) can stun you.

edits.before: At level 3 her CC chain and kite keep you from killing her.
edits.after: At level 3 her knockup into stun chain keeps you off her.

edits.before: Through level 4 her tankiness and CC still shut down your DPS.
edits.after: At 4-5 her tank stats and CC still shut down your DPS output.

edits.before: At level 5 her CC and approaching R keep kill pressure hers.
edits.after: At 6 Glacial Prison (R) stuns through Highlander's immunity.

edits.before: Sejuani is a tanky nightmare early: Arctic Assault (Q) knocks you up, Permafrost (E) stuns once Frost stacks proc, and her Winter's Wrath (W) plus tank stats mean you can't kill her while she CC-chains and kites you.
edits.after: Sejuani is a tanky nightmare early: Arctic Assault (Q) knocks you up, Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost so Permafrost (E) can stun you, and damaging a stunned target shatters it for heavy magic damage you cannot trade through.

edits.before: Her Glacial Prison (R) is a long-range stun on a big cooldown - it's a hard peel against your all-in, and if she lands it you get frozen out of your DPS, so 6 is still firmly hers.
edits.after: Her Glacial Prison (R) is a 1300-range stun on 120s at rank 1 - hard peel against your all-in, and Highlander's immunity covers slows and not stuns, so level 6 is still firmly hers.

edits.before: Through level 5 and her level 6 Glacial Prison (R) she stays ahead - the long-range R stun is a hard answer to your all-in, and her CC chain out-values anything you can do pre-item. Track her R and E cooldowns and refuse to commit while they're up.
edits.after: Through level 5 and her level 6 Glacial Prison (R) she stays ahead - a 1300-range stun on 120s is a hard answer to your all-in, and her CC out-values anything you do pre-item. Permafrost (E) is only 1.5s, so track Frost stacks and her R, not her E.

edits.before: Track her E (Arctic Assault stun) — it's her only point-and-click hard-CC that catches you out of Alpha Strike. If you bait or dodge the E cast, her trade and gank-setup collapse for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Track her Frost stacks, not Permafrost's cooldown — E is 1.5s and point-and-click but only fires at max Frost. Deny the Winter's Wrath (W) hits that build them and the stun never lands; Arctic Assault (Q) is her 12-18s gap-closer.

edits.before: Time Alpha Strike's untargetability to eat her Arctic Assault stun cast — blinking through it wastes her only point-and-click lockdown and buys your whole trade window.
edits.after: Time Alpha Strike's untargetability through Permafrost (E) — but it is back in 1.5s, so the real win is dodging Winter's Wrath (W) so her Frost stacks never reach max and the stun cannot fire.

edits.before: Never auto-trade into her — she wins extended autos via Permafrost slow + W percent damage. Your only good trade is Alpha Strike onto her to proc on-hit and instantly back off before a Permafrost stack lands; anything longer hands her the stun window.
edits.after: Never auto-trade into her — Winter's Wrath (W) swings twice, slows, and stacks Frost toward the stun. Alpha Strike in to proc on-hit and back off before Frost caps; and never channel Meditate in her range, because Permafrost or Glacial Prison cancels it outright.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are false positives — Glacial Prison is the correct Riot name for her R and both lines were left alone. The real name error was in the full layer, where breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d call the stun 'Arctic Assault' (that is her Q knockup). Level chart matches the packet, so no chart edits.
